Netanagri Full Episode:
In her autobiography, Sonia Gandhi spared those leaders within the Congress with whom she had differences, but she held nothing back when it came to her sister-in-law, Maneka Gandhi. She has written candidly about the conflicts involving the 'younger daughter-in-law' (chhoti bahu) and the family; following the release of this book by Sonia, have the prospects for any improvement in Varun Gandhi’s relationship with Rahul and Priyanka now been completely extinguished?
